assertions.title: Duplicate entity with particle emitter creates new GPU emitter

steps.action: Code review of duplicate_entity function in editor/mod.rs
steps.expected: When ParticleEmitterComponent exists, duplicate_entity calls create_emitter() on the particle system
steps.observed: Confirmed in source code (lines ~492-510 of editor/mod.rs): duplicate_entity checks for ParticleEmitterComponent on source entity, copies config, sets emitter_handle to None, adds component to new entity, then if active && particle_system is Some, calls ps.create_emitter(emitter_config) and assigns the returned handle to the new entity's emitter. New handle guaranteed distinct from source.
